title: DOW-UAP-PR19, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, May 2022
doc_notes: This document is a declassified USCENTCOM mission report (MISREP) detailing an ISR flight in May 2022 that recorded five UAP observations, with significant portions redacted under 1.4(a) and other exemptions.

incidents.summary: Observation of five unidentified objects during an ISR mission; one described as a possible missile and four as possible birds.
incidents.quote: observed 5x UAP fly across the screen
